messages.subject: Scaling Posterior means
parts:
i am trying to model a soil carbon fraction using INLA and the resulting posterior means do not come on same scale as my response variable. i have read that Link function in INLA call has something to do with it. How can i use the Link function to get my posterior means on same scale as response variable? any help in this regard will be highly appreciated. 

regards,
Waqas

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Scaling Posterior means
parts:
you need to set the 'link' argument to say which family that NA observation is
related to.

if you do not set anything (same as link=NA), then it is using the identity link

see attached
